name: coleam00/mcp-mem0
ontology_notes: Three tools over mem0.Memory: save_memory(text), search_memories(query, limit=3), get_all_memories. DEFAULT_USER_ID is the string user. CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS in src/utils.py are commented out (custom_fact_extraction_prompt is not set). Last push observed 2025-04-13.

ontology.evidence: src/main.py save_memory stores a single text string. No typed slots. Mem0 may extract facts internally, but this repo does not name types.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Agent tool save_memory calls mem0_client.add(messages, user_id=DEFAULT_USER_ID). No pin, no refuse.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: search_memories uses mem0_client.search with default limit 3. get_all_memories dumps all. Tool docstring tells the model to search before decisions. Retrieve-nothing happens when search returns [].
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: This repo never updates or deletes. Whether mem0.add consolidates is Mem0 OSS behavior, not implemented here.
supersession.label: inferred

temporal.evidence: No timestamp field on save_memory. search_memories has only query and limit.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: DEFAULT_USER_ID = "user" in src/main.py. One bag for the whole server.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: search_memories returns top-k by Mem0 semantic rank. No skip control.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No filter on text before add. CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS exist but are not wired.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No delete tool in src/main.py. Only save, search, get_all.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: utils.get_mem0_client configures an LLM (openai/openrouter/ollama) and an embedder plus Supabase vector_store. Each save_memory is a Mem0 add (extract LLM plus embed). Search is embed plus vector lookup. get_all dumps up to 50 items.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT. Ollama branch in utils.py. Requires DATABASE_URL for Supabase. Not a single-machine file store.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Community FastMCP server. SSE or stdio via TRANSPORT env. README is explicit it is a template.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: One hardcoded user_id, three tools, no delete, no typed memory. A Mem0 tutorial, not a companion store.
open_unknowns: Whether anyone still runs this template after mem0-mcp was archived.
Mem0 OSS extract/update rules behind Memory.add are not in this repo.
